# Adventure

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Adventure)*

An adventure is a series of encounters. A story emerges through playing them. *See also* "[Encounter](Encounter.md)."
